title: “Don’t Forget the Teachers”: Towards an Educator-Centered Understanding of Harms from Large Language Models in Education

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through semi-structured interviews with educators who reported personal classroom experiences with LLM tools generating negative stereotypes about Black children and failing to generate content inclusive of non-white people.
Qualitative evaluation through semi-structured interviews with educators who identified and reported the generation of 'Eurocentric' outputs by educational LLMs.

Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with educators addressing how LLM-based edtech exacerbates systemic inequalities, specifically focusing on the income-level gaps and financial burdens that prevent struggling school districts from accessing premium tools.
